comparison: independent public JavaScript PolicyNet scalar accumulation versus native PyTorch

checkpoint_provenance.used_for: fixed-input numerical reference only; native training starts from random initialization

input_construction.frame: soft-limit centered joint position; zero joint velocities; exported TCP world pose; zero twist and previous actions
input_construction.history: for input i: current frame i, followed by frames (i+j)%8 for j=0..28 and frame i last
input_construction.purpose: fixed numerical minibatch; histories intentionally mix reset frames and are not physical rollouts

weight_mapping.normalizer: first D float32 values are mean, next D variance; remaining tensor offsets from policy JSON

training_conventions.normalizer_updates: native population-moment accumulation; author update rule not public in inference export
training_conventions.critic: native privileged critic; no exported critic weights or exact critic feature list available
training_conventions.legacy_compatibility: architecture_version defaults legacy_v1; new study nominal config explicitly selects official_v1
training_conventions.official_history: current_history layout: current first, then 30 history frames including current
training_conventions.normalization: replace non-finite raw features by zero, (x-mean)/sqrt(var+1e-8), clip [-10,10]

regression_tests.controlled_golden: independent public JavaScript network using deterministic periodic tensors; no external weights needed during unit tests

limitations: This is inference and auxiliary-logit numerical parity, not a PPO minibatch or learning-effect equivalence claim.
Author weights are not committed and do not initialize the native RL reproduction.
The public checkpoint uses a deployed gripper/geometry distribution; this task attempts a nominal study peg first.

reproduction.requirements: Node.js and ordinary native RL Python dependencies; CPU only, no MuJoCo version change needed
reproduction.source_integrity: Every downloaded or cached source asset must match its hard-coded SHA-256; changed bytes fail with a nonzero exit code. Author weights remain in the cache.
reproduction.outputs: JSON raw data, public JavaScript outputs, native outputs, fixed observations, and one Markdown report with three tables
